### Freshness
The MCP server watches the indexed tree and folds edits in as they land, so queries track your work without a polling cycle. Turn `native_watch` off in settings only if the watcher ever costs too much — a periodic `codegraph sync` takes over at `reconcile_interval_s`.

One index covers the whole workspace: the root repo plus every nested repo under the paths in `include_ignored`. Each nested repo's own `.gitignore` is still respected.

The MCP server starts on the first tool call rather than at boot, so "0 tools" right after a restart is normal and resolves itself the moment an agent asks something.

### Rebuild
A full rebuild re-parses every file from scratch. You only need it after changing which paths are indexed, or if a query returns something the source clearly contradicts. Runs in the background.
